model_provider_session_bindings.reason: Provider session origin is immutable and looked up by authenticated workspace plus scoped digest; it preserves the original instance identity after instance deletion and does not consume generic row identity or time pagination.

plugin_credentials.reason: Plugin outbound credentials are encrypted values addressed by publisher namespace, plugin code, scope and credential identity; reads and writes use that full composite key rather than chronological resource pagination.

plugin_schema_version_objects.reason: Version membership is an immutable set keyed by plugin owner, admitted version and ownership key; ownership_key references the system schema catalog and owner/version prefix supports all membership lookups.

application_log_deletion_jobs.reason: Deletion jobs are addressed by application_id and scope_id with newest-job chronology, while pending work uses the existing status-filtered index.

application_log_deletion_records.reason: Deletion worksets use composite job_id and record_id identity, inherit scope from the owning deletion job and cascade with canonical task records.

application_log_deletion_stop_requests.reason: A stop request is one presence fact per deletion job, inherits job authorization and is removed with the job rather than tracked as mutable business metadata.

application_log_upload_receipts.reason: Upload receipts use application_id source_id event_id identity and point to canonical task and trajectory rows; replay lookup never scans workspace chronology.

departments.reason: Departments are accessed through scope_id and parent_id tree adjacency and sibling-rank indexes; scope chronology is not an organization query contract.

department_role_bindings.reason: Role binding identity and authorization derive from scope_id department_id and role_id; the relation carries no independent mutable timestamp lifecycle.

user_department_bindings.reason: Department memberships use workspace user and department relation identity with a transactional primary-department invariant rather than independent timestamp chronology.

mcp_oauth_state.reason: Host-owned OAuth client registration and browser-bound one-time state use (kind, token_hash) identity and explicit expires_at; not workspace CRUD resources. Client registrations are durable, transient states expire and are atomically consumed.

mcp_oauth_grants.reason: Host-owned OAuth grant is scoped through user_id and api_key_id; payload carries workspace-bound authorization. Its lifecycle is expiry/revocation, not user-editable workspace CRUD; no generic scope or timestamp columns are consumed by the repository.

mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens.reason: One-way token_hash identifies a refresh token; grant_id foreign key cascades revocation retention cleanup. expires_at and consumed govern atomic rotation and replay rejection, rather than generic workspace CRUD timestamps.

client_trajectory_archive_blocks.reason: immutable archive blocks use request and block identity and inherit scope through their capture owner

client_trajectory_archive_heads.reason: request identity owns the archive before optional flow run binding and cursor updates

client_trajectory_archive_parts.reason: archive parts use part identity and request foreign key for bounded cursor retrieval

client_trajectory_archive_segments.reason: sealed segment directories use block identity and request foreign key for cursor retrieval

node_run_details.reason: payload sections use node run and section composite identity with cascade ownership

runtime_native_snapshot_items.reason: immutable snapshot items carry scope and application foreign key with content hash identity

runtime_native_snapshot_manifests.reason: immutable snapshot manifests carry scope and application foreign key with content hash identity

runtime_native_snapshot_references.reason: manifest and item foreign keys form immutable composite identity for snapshot references

runtime_observation_body_ownership.reason: content foreign key records ownership only and cascades with canonical content lifecycle

console_permission_catalog_sync.reason: one global singleton records catalog initialization with singleton identity and no workspace lifecycle columns

console_permission_catalog_groups.reason: global catalog groups use group-kind plus group-id identity and retain their first observed timestamp

console_permission_catalog_operations.reason: global catalog operations use stable operation-id identity and retain their first observed timestamp

native_plugin_application_requests.reason: host extension application requests use composite generation identity and immutable created-at audit facts

native_plugin_targets.reason: host extension target selection uses composite installation identity while retaining explicit update lifecycle fields

plugin_settings_template_applications.reason: verified native template application uses composite generation identity with applied-at as immutable completion time

plugin_settings_template_defaults.reason: verified native template defaults use installation and contribution composite identity without lifecycle history columns

lifecycle_outbox.reason: lifecycle events use event_id as identity and mutate explicit delivery state while remaining globally bounded by pending and transaction indexes

lifecycle_outbox_deliveries.reason: subscriber delivery rows are bounded children of one lifecycle event and use event_id plus subscriber_id as identity while explicit claim and delivery timestamps track mutable state

plugin_data_idempotency_receipts.reason: plugin data requests use the owner workspace provider and idempotency key composite identity and retain immutable request and response receipts

plugin_schema_ownership.reason: managed schema ownership uses ownership_key as the global object identity and owner indexes bound all catalog queries

plugin_schema_reconcile_receipts.reason: schema reconcile receipts use receipt_id and owner fingerprint identity with applied_at as their immutable completion timestamp

credit_event_outbox.reason: outbox rows are identified by event_id, routed by workspace_id, and mutate only delivery lifecycle columns (locked_by, locked_until, published_at, last_error) instead of a generic updated_at

network_egress_pool_members.reason: pool members inherit the fixed system scope from their global pool and retain provider keys as explicit invalid references

network_egress_route_pool_members.reason: route-member association rows use the composite route and member identity, sequence defines order, and workspace ownership derives from the route

network_egress_projections.reason: provider projections are bounded catalog rows keyed by provider and provider egress key with synced_at as source freshness

network_egress_provider_secrets.reason: provider secrets are bounded child rows keyed by provider_id; encrypted payload identity and updated_at replace generic row history

network_egress_routes.reason: egress routes are workspace-routed policy rows keyed by consumer selector; workspace_id is the owning scope

user_credit_accounts.reason: credit accounts are routed by (workspace_id, user_id, credit_unit) with a workspace_id + updated_at listing index; scope_id expansion is deferred to a dedicated billing scope migration

workspace_billing_settings.reason: one billing settings row per workspace uses workspace_id as its stable identity and is bounded by the workspaces table

assistant_conversations.reason: assistant conversations use conversation_id as their stable identity and the scoped user application updated index matches the bounded listing contract

application_extension_sources.reason: one extension source row is bounded by its owning application and uses application_id as its stable identity

authentication_connections.reason: authentication connections define global identity namespaces shared by login entries and user identities, not workspace-owned data

login_entries.reason: system login entry configuration selects a global authentication connection before workspace routing

i18n_catalog_release_files.reason: release files are bounded immutable children keyed by release locale and path

i18n_catalog_release_messages.reason: release messages are bounded immutable children keyed by release and catalog key

i18n_catalog_release_translations.reason: release translations are bounded immutable children keyed by release key and locale

i18n_catalog_releases.reason: catalog releases are immutable global release records outside workspace row routing

model_catalog_sync_runs.reason: catalog sync runs are bounded operational history owned through catalog_source_id and reviewed before high-frequency retention work

model_change_logs.reason: model change logs are bounded audit history; data_model_id = null is limited to create failure, delete result, historical, or failed-before-parent rows

model_failover_queue_items.reason: failover queue items are a bounded queue-template child list with template-local ordering

model_provider_catalog_entries.reason: model provider catalog entries are a bounded catalog projection keyed by catalog source and upstream model

mcp_upstream_connection_secrets.reason: one encrypted secret projection is bounded by each upstream connection and uses upstream_connection_id as its stable identity

extension_artifact_instances.reason: bounded extension artifact projection is keyed by unified installation and node without unbounded history

plugin_artifact_cleanup_jobs.reason: system-scoped artifact cleanup obligations are keyed by node and provider; retry mutations use last_attempt_at and last_error, while listing is ordered by node and creation time

retained_frontend_module_assets.reason: immutable module assets are bounded by one system extension installation and composite content identity

mcp_extension_bundle_imports.reason: one MCP bundle import result is bounded by workspace and unified extension installation composite identity

plugin_package_catalog_projection.reason: bounded plugin package catalog projection is one row per plugin installation and does not introduce unbounded expansion history

role_console_group_policies.reason: console group policies are bounded by the owning role and compiled console group catalog

role_console_operation_policies.reason: console operation overrides are bounded by the owning role and compiled operation catalog

role_console_group_policy_snapshots.reason: group policy snapshots are bounded children of one console policy migration run

role_console_operation_policy_snapshots.reason: operation policy snapshots are bounded children of one console policy migration run

workspace_console_settings_order_items.reason: console settings order items are bounded by the owning workspace order and use workspace plus group as their stable composite identity

workspace_console_settings_orders.reason: one mutable console settings order row is bounded by each workspace and uses workspace_id as both owner and stable identity

role_console_policy_migration_actor_prev.reason: actor previews are bounded by one console policy migration run and its captured actor set

role_console_policy_migration_cutover_st.reason: console policy cutover state is one system singleton and is not workspace-routed history

role_console_policy_migration_ledger.reason: console policy migration ledger is bounded release history owned through role_id and migration revision fingerprints

role_console_policy_migration_role_previ.reason: role previews are bounded by one console policy migration run and the captured role set

role_console_policy_migration_run_artifa.reason: compiled migration artifacts are one bounded snapshot per console policy migration run

role_console_policy_migration_runs.reason: console policy migration runs are low volume system release history keyed by migration revision

role_data_model_policies.reason: data model policy overrides are bounded by the owning role and registered data model set

role_data_policies.reason: default data policies are one bounded policy row per owning role

ui_code_template_defaults.reason: UI code template defaults are one bounded system-scoped mapping per provider contribution and use the composite primary key as stable identity

tenants.reason: tenant routing root reference uses tenant id as the root route key and must not invent workspace scope

users.reason: global user identity reference is shared by login and membership flows and is not routed by workspace scope

user_auth_identities.reason: global auth identity reference follows the login user identity and is not owned by workspace routing scope

workspaces.reason: workspace routing root uses workspaces.id as the workspace routing scope and should not duplicate scope_id

workspace_i18n_catalog_custom_translatio.reason: custom translations are bounded workspace projections keyed by catalog key and locale

workspace_i18n_catalog_states.reason: catalog state is one bounded revision root keyed directly by workspace id

workspace_i18n_catalog_obsolete_messages.reason: obsolete markers are bounded workspace projections keyed by one catalog key

workspace_i18n_catalog_overrides.reason: translation overrides are bounded workspace projections keyed by catalog key and locale

schema_migrations.reason: sqlx internal migration ledger, not application-managed user data

flow_run_recovery_history.reason: immutable recovery history is addressed by flow run sequence and never by a scope chronology scan

flow_run_resume_claims.reason: resume claims are addressed by flow run target and status rather than a scope chronology scan

frontstage_executable_upgrade_markers.reason: global executable upgrade markers use the marker as identity and are not workspace routed application data

frontstage_executable_upgrade_runs.reason: global upgrade attempts are bounded by their marker and run id instead of workspace row routing

client_trajectory_captures.reason: client capture integrity is a bounded one-row-per-request projection keyed by request_id and linked to runtime event evidence

client_trajectory_steps.reason: client trajectory steps are bounded event projections keyed by request and event identity with pagination indexes on flow runs

client_trajectory_sections.reason: client trajectory sections are bounded event projections keyed by event_id and request with section-specific evidence ordering

client_trajectory_node_links.reason: client trajectory node links are a bounded many-to-many correlation projection keyed by request_id and node_run_id, sourced from runtime_events and scoped through the owning flow run

runtime_canonical_contents.reason: canonical content is immutable and addressed by application plus content hash rather than a scope chronology scan

runtime_invocation_context_bindings.reason: one immutable binding uses invocation span as identity and is read through the owning flow runtime

runtime_legacy_shadow_batches.reason: conversion shadow batches are global operational migration state rather than workspace owned application data

runtime_legacy_shadow_rows.reason: conversion shadow rows are immutable evidence addressed by batch or flow rather than a scope chronology scan

notification_instances.reason: Notification channel configuration uses non-null workspace identity and workspace created_at id lookup; dedicated notification services own access and this table is not a generic scope chronology consumer.

system_notifications.reason: Inbox history uses workspace recipient chronology with stable instance identity and monotonic read_at acknowledgement; it survives recipient or channel deletion and has no generic editable updated_at lifecycle.

notification_send_logs.reason: Send attempts retain workspace, actor and instance identities without cascading foreign keys; repositories fence pending to terminal status and completed_at by workspace and id. Queries use workspace created_at id and workspace instance created_at id indexes, not generic scope chronology or an editable updated_at lifecycle.

plugin_contribution_authorization_revisi.reason: Authority revision state is addressed by installation and workspace, where canonical nil denotes a declared managed system service. Validation and workspace-deletion triggers preserve this mixed owner domain; snapshots and locks use the composite identity rather than generic scope chronology.

plugin_contribution_authorizations.reason: Authorization history belongs to the validated installation/workspace revision identity through a cascading composite foreign key, including canonical managed system authority. Grant and revoke facts retain their own timestamps, revision and scoped lookup indexes rather than independent scope chronology.
